meta.note: Audit simulation on 100% synthetic data. Contractors, work orders and notices are fictional; figures exist to demonstrate an audit workflow, not to accuse anyone.

flag_reason_labels.DLP_VIOLATION: Warranty ignored — the road was still under the contractor's free-repair warranty (DLP), so BMC shouldn't have paid at all
flag_reason_labels.OVERBILLED: Overcharged — billed more than 30% above the government rate card for this repair
flag_reason_labels.DOUBLE_BILLED: Billed twice — same road & same work billed again within 7 days with no citizen complaint linked

methodology.DLP_VIOLATION: road.under_dlp == 'Y' → whole cost_inr recoverable from the original contractor
methodology.OVERBILLED: cost_inr > 1.30 × expected_cost (rate card × area for per-sqm, flat rate for per-job) → cost − expected recoverable
methodology.DOUBLE_BILLED: same road_id + work_type re-billed within 7 days, linked_complaint_ids blank → duplicate cost_inr recoverable
methodology.recoverable_inr: max of the applicable flag amounts, so overlapping flags are never double-counted
